structured_output.summary: Phase 27 delivers a genuinely additive, mechanically verified TypeScript 0.35.0 directional-profile implementation. I independently confirmed: upstream shapes at the pinned source match the overlay; the 12 cloned ancestors plus 4 new nodes leave every historical node/root intact; profiles.rs repoints exactly two request-schema arguments; projections are lossless and typed-wins; request validation precedes auth/I/O; new types are Debug-redacted; the 906-case Zod oracle is replayed in Rust on 1.89.0 and 1.99.0; regeneration is byte-compared from the frozen inventory; tamper cases fail closed; the private scan and live receipt bind this exact source. Documentation and live/release scoping are candid. Both chunks were accepted at this SHA, but all five chunk-level low findings remain unfixed, concentrated in supportability (unbound wire tests, hand-asserted upstream key sets, an inert test branch, misleading messages, missing format-site inventory).

findings.description: sourceBindings pin profiles.rs, tests/typescript035_models.rs and the example, but not crates/scm-sdk/tests/management_contracts.rs, which holds this phase's actual wire qualification (lines 1725-2044). No owner asserts the four directional wire test function names, unlike tools/red_team_management.py:765-768 which greps MANAGEMENT_WIRE_TESTS out of its contract test. Renaming or deleting directional_profiles_preserve_all_wire_paths_and_both_response_policies, current_profile_requests_reject_new_invalid_fields_before_authentication, valid_raw_directional_extensions_submit_and_decode_typed_responses or profile_wire_defaults_and_empty_terminal_pages_follow_request_options would fail no check.
findings.required_fix: Add crates/scm-sdk/tests/management_contracts.rs to the parity ledger sourceBindings and assert the four directional wire test function names in tools/typescript035_profiles.py --check, mirroring red_team_management.py's verify_runtime_adoption name check.

findings.description: The two genuinely new upstream declarations are not span-pinned: verify_reused_profile_declarations (tools/verify_typescript035_source.py:58) only pins declarations present in the frozen 0.34.0 inventory. The overlay hand-transcribes the four protection keys, the four direction keys and unconditionally overrides inputPresence/inputNull; the ledger's addedExports=4 / projectedFields=5 counts are asserted rather than derived from the pinned src/models/index.ts delta. At this pin the transcription is correct (mgmt-security-profile.ts:239-269; index.ts:132-135 adds exactly the four names), but a future re-pin adding a fifth typed key or export would pass generation silently and be treated as passthrough.
findings.required_fix: Span-pin ContentTypeConfigurationSchema/ContentTypeConfigurationsSchema text and sha256 in verify_typescript035_source.py, derive or assert the overlay property key sets from that pinned text, and derive the added-export count by diffing the pinned index.ts export names against contracts/typescript.json.

findings.description: test_frozen_contracts_and_planning_sdk_bytes keeps the frozen contract byte assertions unconditional (189-191) but bare-`return`s from the SDK-freeze block when active_phase != 26. Under active_phase 27 that half of the test is inert yet recorded as a plain pass in the phase receipt, so executed and skipped coverage are indistinguishable.
findings.required_fix: Replace the bare return with self.skipTest('phase 26 planning boundary only') so the phase-27 receipt records the skip explicitly.

findings.description: verify_service_qualification is now reached from --check --current-source-compatibility (line 869-870), but both failure messages still read 'Phase 24 requires fresh bounded read-only management qualification' and 'Phase 24 requires explicit exercised and unexercised endpoint profiles'. A phase-27 qualification failure would be diagnosed as a phase-24 gate failure.
findings.required_fix: Reword both messages to name the current-source bounded read-only qualification rather than phase 24.

findings.description: The frozen format inventory now skips every root prefixed 'typescript:' as well as 'vendor:', so the six new versioned 0.35.0 roots contribute no formatSites rows (allFrozenRootsWithFormats stays 190). Their reachable format constraints (for example CreateSecurityProfileRequest last_modified_ts datetime, integer revision) have no static inventory anywhere; only the oracle's executed acceptance covers them.
findings.required_fix: Record the versioned roots' reachable format sites in a separately counted section (for example in contracts/typescript-035-parity.json) so the new roots have a static format inventory alongside the oracle outcomes.
